program.section_heading: LVN to RN (30 Unit Option), CA
outcomes: The student will implement nursing care to patients, families, and groups from diverse backgrounds in a variety of settings that is compassionate, age and culturally appropriate and based on a patient`s preferences, values and needs.
The student will participate as a member of the interprofessional healthcare team in the provision of safe, quality patient-centered care.
The student will identify best current evidence from scientific and other credible sources as a basis for developing individualized patient-centered plans of care.
The student will participate in data collection processes that support established quality improvementinitiatives.
The student will implement strategies that minimize risk and provide a safe environment for patients, self, and others.
The student will use evidence-based information and patient care technology in the provision of safe, quality patientcentered care.

notes: Codes are printed without a space (e.g. 'NURS3'); NURS3, NURS4 and NURS20 match closed-list NURS 3, NURS 4 and NURS 20.

Program Prerequisites (BIOL2, BIOL7; Total 8) are counted inside the printed 30-unit total under 'Complete all of the following', so they are recorded as a required block; BIOL2 and BIOL7 are not in the closed list.
Each block says 'Complete the following number of credits' equal to the sum of its listed courses, so both were read as 'all'.
Careers taken from the description ('Registered Nurses (RNs)') and the Career Information heading; the duplicate 'Registered Nurses' entry there was not repeated.
